score.level_basis: L2 verification support: explicit fixtures and finite negative controls with source-bound outcomes.

basis.G1: Legacy origin, source paths, migration versions and SHA-256 binding are recorded. Contract names the narrow exported claim; AuthorityEffect is None. No external authenticity attestation is claimed.
basis.G2: The source-bound 204-test suite exercises native integer typing, independent finite task checking, scoped grammar preservation and/or this module through its corresponding runner. No arbitrary English equivalence or causal learning claim. 2026-11-05 committee fixes: WF4/WF5 per-agent receipts check the exact total; a malformed vendor envelope no longer loses a charged reply; replay ties response bytes to the retained wire body; a broken dispatch barrier still closes its reservation; the WF3 L2 recheck is documented as schema-pinned. Regression tests cover the first three.
basis.G3: Observed refusal controls cover malformed bindings, missing slots, wrong unanimous answers, unknown costs, aggregate budget refusal and changed replay bytes. Native absence is typed. External provider behavior beyond injected wire fixtures remains unverified live.
basis.G4: D: executed regression and negative controls are source-bound, including all five CLI paths. No implementation-mutation campaign or new live model trial was run, so no mutation ratio or statistical efficacy is claimed. This is an explicit verification audit deficit, not a fabricated unassessed pass.
basis.G5: Measured CCN 12, cognitive 16, nesting 2; ceiling B. Reused orchestration has remaining complexity and deliberate owner delegation; no unmeasured optimality claim.

evidence.note: 204 offline tests after the 2026-11-05 committee fixes; exact source inputs bound. No live model performance claim.
